slot.brief: Count arrangements of words where certain letters are never adjacent (complementary counting).

stem: How many distinct arrangements of the letters of COMPUTER have the letters C and O not adjacent?

verdicts.working: All 8 letters are distinct. Total arrangements: 8! = 40320. With C and O adjacent: 2 × 7! = 10080. Thus nonadjacent: 40320 − 10080 = 30240.

Independent check: All 8 letters are distinct. Total arrangements: 8! = 40320. With C and O adjacent: 2 × 7! = 10080. Thus nonadjacent: 40320 − 10080 = 30240.
solution:
All 8 letters are distinct, so total arrangements are $8!$. Treating C and O as one block gives $2\cdot7!$ arrangements with them adjacent.
$$8!-2\cdot7!=40320-10080=30240$$
